perQuery.note: Elicit ranks both landmark trials first, while Manan misses PARTNER 3 and includes irrelevant items in the top 10.
Both retrieve the exact DAPA-HF paper first, but Manan provides a fuller clinically useful surrounding evidence set.
Elicit includes CLARITY-AD first and the 36-month OLE, whereas Manan omits the landmark trial despite recent metadata-rich results.
Manan includes high-quality contemporary meta-analyses plus major CVOTs, while Elicit is narrower and older with no landmark CVOTs in the top results.
Manan includes the current 2024 ESC guideline and multiple official guideline versions, though it ranks older guidelines above the latest one.
Neither system retrieves the pivotal individual DOAC RCTs, but Manan ranks stronger meta-analytic evidence first and avoids Elicit's top-ranked news-summary result.

overall.summary: Manan wins four of six queries, largely because its metadata is complete and it often surfaces higher-quality synthesis or guideline evidence. Elicit is clearly better on landmark/exact recall for TAVR and lecanemab, where Manan's ranking and omission of must-have trials are serious weaknesses.
